about: Synthetic context-quality dataset for the M8 context layer (services/memory/snapshot.py assemble_context, services/memory/changes.py detect). One invented person, Meera Raghavan of Coimbatore; every name, employer, amount and account number is made up. Times are days relative to the run (negative = in the past). Records are stored the way Life Graph really stores them: memories (with properties.fact_type, tags, source_type, trust_tier, extraction_tier, status, valid_from/valid_until, supersedes/superseded_by, properties.superseded_at), entities + memory_entities (services/entities.py link), memory_links (ASSOCIATED via services/memory/associations.py said_together; typed BECAUSE/LEADS_TO/CONTRADICTS rows as models/memory.py MemoryLink), life_graph.decisions, intentions and pending contradiction approvals. No new table or column is used.
person: Meera Raghavan, 34, senior backend engineer at Kovai Logistics (Coimbatore). Husband Arjun (maths teacher), daughter Ila (7), mother Kamala (type 2 diabetes, lives with them).

no_structured_home.goal: No goal table. A stated goal lands as a memory with fact_type 'intention' (extraction prompt: goals map to intention) and a 'goal' tag.
no_structured_home.project: The projects table is for code repositories (kernel/project_registry.py) and is not linked to memories or entities. A personal or work project the owner talks about is a memory plus an entity row for its name.
no_structured_home.task: agent_tasks are agent/dev runs, connector_items tasks need Google Tasks. A work task the owner mentions is a memory, and the promise to do it may also be an intention.
no_structured_home.constraint: No constraint record. A constraint or budget limit is a memory (fact or explicit_save).
no_structured_home.dependency_or_blocker: No dependency edge between projects/tasks. A blocker is a memory; a typed memory_links row (BECAUSE / LEADS_TO) can join two memories, but retrieval only follows ASSOCIATED links.
no_structured_home.responsibility: No responsibility record; a memory naming the person (entity link).
no_structured_home.skill_progress_prerequisite: No learning model; memories with tags.
no_structured_home.decision_consequence: memory_links join memories only; a decision (life_graph.decisions) cannot be linked to the memory that records its consequence. Only decision supersession (superseded_by) is structured.
no_structured_home.deadline: Only intentions carry a machine-readable time (trigger_time / expires_at). A deadline said in a memory is text only.

change_scenario.about: Owner question 6 (what changed professionally). A separate throwaway tenant holds the owner's work records as they were 7 days ago; a Jarvis turn then keeps the snapshot of that state in its trace (agent_tasks.result.trace.context_snapshot, format 2). The records then change the way the real paths change them (a supersession, a decision superseded, a commitment completed, new blockers and news, a pending contradiction). This turn's snapshot is assembled and services/memory/changes.py detect() compares it with the trace. Gold = the professional changes a person would expect to hear about.
